taskTitle: Design a telescopic-cascode fully differential OTA
circuit:
* Sky130 telescopic-cascode fully differential OTA.
* Differential path: NMOS input pair + NMOS cascode + PMOS-LVT cascode + PMOS
* top current sources, biased from the 50 uA iref reference.
* Common-mode feedback: resistive output-CM sense into an NMOS differential
* pair whose PMOS diode load sets the top current-source gate rail.
.subckt telescopic_cascode_ota vss iref vdd vinn vinp vocm voutn voutp

* ---------------- 50 uA reference and bias rails ----------------
* Reference diode (bench forces 50 uA into iref).
XREF    iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=20 nf=1

* PMOS gate rail vbp (20 uA) for the p-side current sources.
XNBP    vbp iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=8 nf=1
XPBP    vbp vbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=22 nf=1

* NMOS cascode gate: vcn = I*R2 + Vgs(nfet diode at the cascode density).
XPCS    vcn vbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=22 nf=1
XND     vcn vcn vcnl vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=24 nf=1
R2      vcnl vss 20k

* PMOS cascode gate: vbpc = vdd - I*R1 - |Vgs(lvt diode)|.
R1      vdd yb 20k
XPD     vbpc vbpc yb vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.75 w=12 nf=1
XND2    vbpc iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=8 nf=1

* ---------------- differential signal path ----------------
XTAIL   tail iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=80 nf=2
XINP    a1 vinp tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.75 w=130 nf=2
XINN    a2 vinn tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.75 w=130 nf=2
XNCASP  voutn vcn a1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=120 nf=2
XNCASN  voutp vcn a2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=120 nf=2
XPTOPN  pn vctrl vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=46.5 nf=11
XPTOPP  pp vctrl vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=46.5 nf=11
XPCASN  voutn vbpc pn vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.75 w=60 nf=2
XPCASP  voutp vbpc pp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.75 w=60 nf=2

* ---------------- output common-mode feedback ----------------
* Resistive CM sense with speed-up capacitors.
RS1     voutp cms 100meg
RS2     voutn cms 100meg
CS1     voutp cms 0.5p
CS2     voutn cms 0.5p
* NMOS pair: XCM1 senses vocm (diode branch), XCM2 senses the output CM.
XCMTAIL cmt iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=16 nf=1
XCM1    vctrl vocm cmt vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=100 nf=2
XCM2    cmd  cms  cmt vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=100 nf=2
XPD1    vctrl vctrl vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=8.8 nf=2
XPD2    cmd  cmd  vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=8.8 nf=2

.ends telescopic_cascode_ota

taskTitle: Design a telescopic-cascode fully differential OTA
circuit:
* Sky130 fully differential telescopic-cascode OTA.
* Top level: vss iref vdd vinn vinp vocm voutn voutp
*   iref : fixed 50 uA reference current (sunk by the reference diode)
*   vocm : output common-mode command
.subckt telescopic_cascode_ota vss iref vdd vinn vinp vocm voutn voutp

*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
* Bias generation.  The 50 uA forced into iref is mirrored to the tail
* source and to the bias rails.
*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
XMR   iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=25 nf=1
XMT   tail iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=70 nf=2

* PMOS bias rail (10 uA into a diode connected PMOS)
XMB1  nb1  iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=5 nf=1
XMPB  nb1  nb1  vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=10 nf=1

* NMOS cascode gate: diode Vgs plus a resistor drop (tracks Vth)
XMB2  nb2  nb2  vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=10 nf=1
RBN   nb3  nb2  57k
XMP2  nb3  nb1  vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=10 nf=1

* PMOS cascode gate: resistor drop from a mirrored 10 uA
XMP3  nb4  nb1  vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=10 nf=1
RBP   nb4  vss  25k

*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
* Telescopic cascode differential pair.
*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
XINP  a1   vinp tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1   w=100 nf=4
XINN  a2   vinn tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1   w=100 nf=4
XNC1  voutn nb3 a1  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1   w=60  nf=2
XNC2  voutp nb3 a2  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1   w=60  nf=2
XPC1  pn   nb4 voutn pn  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=100 nf=4
XPC2  pp   nb4 voutp pp  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=100 nf=4
XPT1  pn   vctrl vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=50 nf=2
XPT2  pp   vctrl vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=50 nf=2

*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
* Continuous-time common-mode feedback.
*   resistive sense (with speed-up caps) -> 5T error amp -> vctrl
*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
RS1   voutp vcm 2meg
RS2   voutn vcm 2meg
CS1   voutp vcm 200f
CS2   voutn vcm 200f
RD    vcm  vocm 1meg
CD    vcm  vss  400f

XCM1  x1   vcm  cms vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=20 nf=1
XCM2  vctrl vocm cms vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=20 nf=1
XCMT  cms  iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=40 nf=2
* D1/D2/D3 are replicas of the output current source (same L, same current
* density), so the balanced CMFB output lands on the gate voltage the top
* PMOS pair actually needs; the loop error is only the residual offset.
* identical finger width in D1/D2 keeps the mirror ratio exactly 1:2
XPD1  x1   x1   vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=28.6 nf=4
XPD2  vctrl x1  vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=14.3 nf=2
XPD3  vctrl vctrl vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=13.0 nf=1

.ends telescopic_cascode_ota

taskTitle: Design a telescopic-cascode fully differential OTA
circuit:
* Fully differential OTA - NMOS-input folded cascode with continuous-time CMFB.
* Interface: .subckt telescopic_cascode_ota vss iref vdd vinn vinp vocm voutn voutp
.subckt telescopic_cascode_ota vss iref vdd vinn vinp vocm voutn voutp

* ------------------------------------------------------------------
* Bias: reference device sinks the fixed 50 uA forced into iref.
* ------------------------------------------------------------------
XREF   iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8  l=1 w=10 nf=1

* Input-pair tail (100 uA) and shared bottom source (100 uA).
XTAIL  tail iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8  l=1 w=20 nf=2
XBOT   srcb iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8  l=2 w=30 nf=2

* ------------------------------------------------------------------
* PMOS current-mirror reference rail (25 uA), used by p-side sinks.
* ------------------------------------------------------------------
XPMREF pmref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8  l=1 w=5 nf=1
XPMDIOD pmref pmref vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=10 nf=1

* ------------------------------------------------------------------
* Cascode bias rails (resistive level shifts of fixed mirror currents).
* ------------------------------------------------------------------
XBPCSRC vbp_casc pmref vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=10 nf=1
RBP     vbp_casc vss 11k
XBNCSNK vbn_casc iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=5 nf=1
RBN     vdd vbn_casc 34k

* AC bypass the two cascode gate rails so they stay quiet in loop.
CBP     vbp_casc vss 2p
CBN     vbn_casc vss 2p

* ------------------------------------------------------------------
* Differential core: NMOS input pair, PMOS cascode out of fold nodes,
* NMOS cascode to shared bottom source, CMFB-regulated PMOS loads.
* ------------------------------------------------------------------
XINP   foldn vinp tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8  l=0.3 w=20 nf=2
XINN   foldp vinn tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8  l=0.3 w=20 nf=2

XPCASN voutn vbp_casc foldn vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=24 nf=2
XPCASP voutp vbp_casc foldp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=24 nf=2

XNCASN voutn vbn_casc srcb vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8  l=1 w=24 nf=2
XNCASP voutp vbn_casc srcb vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8  l=1 w=24 nf=2

XLDN   foldn vctrl vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8  l=1.5 w=80 nf=4
XLDP   foldp vctrl vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8  l=1.5 w=80 nf=4

* ------------------------------------------------------------------
* Continuous-time CMFB: sense average via resistors, NMOS pair with
* PMOS mirror, single-ended output vctrl drives both p-load gates.
* ------------------------------------------------------------------
RCMN   voutn vcm_sense 1meg
RCMP   voutp vcm_sense 1meg
XCMTAIL cm_tail iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=8 nf=1
XCMSL  cm_l vcm_sense cm_tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=8 nf=1
XCMSR  vctrl vocm cm_tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=8 nf=1
XCMLD  cm_l cm_l vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=10 nf=1
XCMOD  vctrl cm_l vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=10 nf=1

.ends telescopic_cascode_ota

taskTitle: Design a telescopic-cascode fully differential OTA
circuit:
* Sky130 fully differential telescopic-cascode OTA
* Interface: vss iref vdd vinn vinp vocm voutn voutp
* 50 uA forced into iref; bench loads each output with 2 pF.
.subckt telescopic_cascode_ota vss iref vdd vinn vinp vocm voutn voutp

* ---------------- bias generation ----------------
* 50 uA reference diode (2 uA per W/L unit) -> NMOS bias rail.
XMREF   iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=25 nf=1
* Tail mirror (4x -> 200 uA), same current density so Vdsat ~ 0.16 V.
XMTAIL  tail iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=100 nf=2

* 10 uA NMOS sink feeding the PMOS bias rail.
XMNBP   pb   iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=5 nf=1
* PMOS rail: |Vov| ~ 0.4 V, tracks the PMOS threshold.
XMPB    pb   pb   vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2.9 nf=1
* NMOS cascode gate: low-W/L diode, tracks the NMOS threshold.
XMPVCN  vcn  pb   vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2.9 nf=1
XMCN    vcn  vcn  vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=0.42 nf=1
* PMOS cascode gate: pb minus 10 uA * 16.4k -> pn sits near 1.35 V.
XMNVCP  vcp  iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=5 nf=1
RVCP    pb   vcp  16.4k

* ---------------- telescopic cascode core ----------------
* LVT input pair: keeps the tail node high enough for the tail device.
XMINP   a1   vinp tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=200 nf=4
XMINN   a2   vinn tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=200 nf=4
XNCASN  voutn vcn a1  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=200 nf=4
XNCASP  voutp vcn a2  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=200 nf=4
* PMOS current sources: |Vov| ~ 0.3 V so |Vds7| ~ 0.45 V keeps them
* saturated; the cascodes run at |Vov| ~ 0.15 V for headroom at 1.125 V.
XMPTOPN pn   vctrl vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=39 nf=2
XMPTOPP pp   vctrl vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=39 nf=2
XPCASN  voutn vcp pn  pn  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=105 nf=2
XPCASP  voutp vcp pp  pp  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=105 nf=2

* ---------------- common-mode feedback ----------------
* Large sense resistors keep the differential load high; the parallel
* capacitors bypass them so the sense node has no low-frequency pole.
RSP     voutp cms 2meg
RSN     voutn cms 2meg
CSP     voutp cms 0.3p
CSN     voutn cms 0.3p
XMCMT   cm_tail iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=40 nf=1
* Output at the drain of the device whose gate is vocm: a rising output
* common mode raises vctrl, which reduces the PMOS source current.
* The diode load tracks the M7 overdrive so the amplifier balance point
* coincides with the gate voltage M7 needs.
XMCM1   vctrl vocm cm_tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=50 nf=1
XMCM2   cma   cms  cm_tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=50 nf=1
XMPD1   vctrl vctrl vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=14 nf=1
XMPD2   cma   cma   vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=14 nf=1

.ends telescopic_cascode_ota

taskTitle: Design a telescopic-cascode fully differential OTA
circuit:
* Sky130 fully differential telescopic-cascode OTA (v4).
* NMOS-input telescopic stack + continuous-time CMFB.
.subckt telescopic_cascode_ota vss iref vdd vinn vinp vocm voutn voutp

* Reference diode (50uA) sets the NMOS mirror gate.
XREF iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=48 nf=8

* Fixed PMOS bias rail vbp (diode PMOS carrying 50uA).
XNBP vbp iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=48 nf=8
XPBP vbp vbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=48 nf=8

* Tail current source: 5x reference (~235uA).
XTAIL tail iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=240 nf=20

* Differential input pair (l=1 for higher ro, W kept so gm unchanged).
XINP a1 vinp tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=80 nf=8
XINN a2 vinn tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=80 nf=8

* NMOS cascode devices.
XNCASP voutn vcn a1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=48 nf=6
XNCASN voutp vcn a2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=48 nf=6

* PMOS top current sources, controlled by the CMFB (vctrl).
XPTOPN pn vctrl vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=60 nf=6
XPTOPP pp vctrl vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=60 nf=6

* PMOS cascode devices.
XPCASN voutn vbpc pn pn sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=144 nf=12
XPCASP voutp vbpc pp pp sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=144 nf=12

* ---- NMOS cascode bias (vcn): ground-referenced diode + resistor ----
* No floating node; vcn = Vgs(diode) + I*R, independent of vdd.
XVTOP vcn vbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=48 nf=8
XVDIO vcn vcn vcnr vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=40 nf=4
RVCN vcnr vss 11k

* ---- PMOS cascode bias (vbpc): replica from fixed vbp ----
XBTOP2 b_p vbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=48 nf=8
XBPCAS2 vbpc vbpc b_p b_p sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=60 nf=6

* top sources by mirroring. Larger diff pair gives higher loop gain.

RCMP voutp vcm_sense 2meg
CBN voutn vcm_sense 100f
CBP voutp vcm_sense 100f
XCMTAIL cm_tail iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=52 nf=8
XCMSENSE cm_right vcm_sense cm_tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=24 nf=4
XCMREF vctrl vocm cm_tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=24 nf=4
XCMDIODE vctrl vctrl vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=12 nf=2
XCMLOAD cm_right cm_right vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=12 nf=2

taskTitle: Design a telescopic-cascode fully differential OTA
circuit:
* Fully differential Sky130 telescopic-cascode OTA.
*
* Bias lineage: the fixed 50 uA into iref biases a diode NMOS; all NMOS bias
* rails mirror it.  Three ~25 uA replica branches create vbp (PMOS mirror
* gate), vcn (NMOS cascode gate) and vbpc (PMOS cascode gate).
*
* Common-mode feedback: source followers buffer each output and a matching
* follower buffers vocm; the average of the follower sources is compared with
* the reference by a PMOS-input differential amplifier that drives the gates
* of the top PMOS current sources.  The amplifier is Miller compensated; the
* compensation network is split symmetrically to the two outputs so
* differential signal charge cancels onto the common control node.
.subckt telescopic_cascode_ota vss iref vdd vinn vinp vocm voutn voutp

* ---- Reference device (carries the forced 50 uA; sets mirror Vgs) ----
XREF iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=16.5 nf=2

* ---- Main differential tail (~180 uA) ----
XTAIL tail iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=60 nf=4

* ---- vbp replica branch: PMOS mirror gate (~25 uA) ----
XNBP vbp iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=8 nf=1
XPBP vbp vbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=20 nf=2

* ---- vcn replica branch: NMOS cascode gate (~25 uA) ----
XPVCN vcn vbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=20 nf=2
XCN1 vcn vcn cnmid vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=25 nf=2
XCN0 cnmid cnmid vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=25 nf=2

* ---- vbpc replica branch: PMOS cascode gate (~25 uA) ----
XPVBP px vbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=20 nf=2
XPCD vbpc vbpc px px sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=40 nf=2
XNBPC vbpc iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=8 nf=1

* ---- Telescopic differential signal stack ----
XINP a1 vinp tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=60 nf=4
XINN a2 vinn tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=60 nf=4
XNCASP voutn vcn a1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=80 nf=4
XNCASN voutp vcn a2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=80 nf=4
XPTOPN pn vctrl vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=80 nf=4
XPTOPP pp vctrl vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=80 nf=4
XPCASN voutn vbpc pn pn sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=144 nf=6
XPCASP voutp vbpc pp pp sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=144 nf=6

* ---- CM detector: buffered resistive averager ----
XSFOP sp voutp vdd vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=4 nf=1
XSFON sn voutn vdd vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=4 nf=1
XSFPIT sp iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=3.4 nf=1
XSFNIT sn iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=3.4 nf=1
RSM1 sp m 50k
RSM2 m sn 50k
XSFR rf vocm vdd vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=4 nf=1
XSFRIT rf iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=3.4 nf=1

* ---- PMOS-input CM error amplifier ----
XCMT pt vbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=14 nf=2
XCMS z m pt vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=14 nf=2
XCMR vctrl rf pt vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=14 nf=2
XNLD z z vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=8 nf=1
XNLR vctrl z vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=8 nf=1

* ---- Miller compensation (nulling resistor cancels the feedforward zero) ----
RZN voutn vzn 900
CZN vzn vctrl 0.9p
RZP voutp vzp 900
CZP vzp vctrl 0.9p
.ends telescopic_cascode_ota

taskTitle: Design a telescopic-cascode fully differential OTA
circuit:
* Fully differential telescopic-cascode OTA, Sky130.
* Pins: vss iref vdd vinn vinp vocm voutn voutp
* 50 uA forced into iref.
* Signal stack: nmos-lvt input pair (gates crossed so voutp-voutn is
* non-inverting vs vinp-vinn, matching the external feedback polarity),
* nmos-lvt cascode, pmos-lvt cascode load; top pmos gates on vctrl.
* Bias: iref diode + density-matched replicas; cascode-gate replica
* diodes run at ~2x signal density so every device keeps saturation
* margin at the ss / 1.62 V / 125 C corner.
* CMFB: resistor-averaged output sense into a current-mirror nmos diff
* amp driving vctrl; Miller compensated vctrl->outputs.
.subckt telescopic_cascode_ota vss iref vdd vinn vinp vocm voutn voutp

* ---- Bias generation ----
XREF   iref iref vss vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1   w=6   nf=1
* Main tail: 3x = 150 uA (75 uA per signal leg).
XTAIL  tail iref vss  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1   w=18  nf=3

* vbp: pmos diode (25 uA, density-matched to the signal top devices)
* pulled down by an nmos current source.
XPBD   vbp  vbp  vdd  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1.5 w=42  nf=6
XNBD   vbp  iref vss  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1.5 w=4   nf=1

* vbpc: 25 uA nmos cs under TWO stacked pmos diodes at ~2x signal
* density.  vdd - 2 Vsg lands vbpc low; the p-cascode source then sits
* high enough to keep the top device saturated at vdd=1.62 V.
XNPS   vbpc iref vss  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1.5 w=4   nf=1
XPCD   vbpc vbpc vdd  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1.5 w=4   nf=1

* vcn: 25 uA pmos cs into two stacked diode nmos devices at ~2x the
* signal density (extra Vgs keeps the n-cascode gate high).
XPNCS  vcn  vbp  vdd  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1.5 w=42  nf=6
XNR1   vcn  vcn  nr0  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1.5 w=20  nf=4
XNR0   nr0  nr0  vss  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1.5 w=20  nf=4

* Bias rail decoupling.
CBP    vbp  vdd  1p
CBPC   vbpc vdd  1p
CCN    vcn  vss  1p

* ---- Telescopic signal stack (75 uA per leg), L=1.5 ----
* Input gates crossed: leg p (->voutp) is driven by vinn and vice versa,
* so differential gain voutp-voutn over vinp-vinn is positive.
XINP   ap   vinn tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1.5 w=120 nf=18
XINN   an   vinp tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1.5 w=120 nf=18
XNCASP voutp vcn ap   vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1.5 w=120 nf=18
XNCASN voutn vcn an   vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1.5 w=120 nf=18
XPTOPP pp   vctrl vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1.5 w=180 nf=30
XPTOPN pn   vctrl vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1.5 w=180 nf=30
XPCASP voutp vbpc pp  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1.5 w=180 nf=30
XPCASN voutn vbpc pn  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1.5 w=180 nf=30

* ---- Common-mode feedback ----
* Resistor average of the outputs.  Large value: the conductance seen
* by each output for differential signals is only 1/R.
RCMN   voutn vcm_sense 2meg
RCMP   voutp vcm_sense 2meg
* Fast CM amp: min-geometry pair keeps the sense-node pole (R/2*Cg)
* high; stout tail so vctrl slews quickly.
XCMT   cmtail iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1   w=3   nf=1
XCMS   d2  vcm_sense cmtail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.8  w=1 nf=1
XCMR   vctrl vocm  cmtail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.8  w=1 nf=1
XPLD   d2  d2   vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.8  w=3 nf=1
XPL1   vctrl d2  vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.8  w=3 nf=1
* Miller compensation vctrl -> outputs (two-stage CM loop); nulling
* resistors place the feedthrough zero in the LHP.
RZMP   mzp  vctrl 700
CZMP   mzp  voutp 1.0p
RZMN   mzn  vctrl 700
CZMN   mzn  voutn 1.0p
.ends telescopic_cascode_ota

taskTitle: Design a telescopic-cascode fully differential OTA
circuit:
* Fully differential telescopic-cascode OTA, Sky130 1.8 V core devices.
* Pins: vss iref vdd vinn vinp vocm voutn voutp
* iref sinks a fixed 50 uA; all internal biases are derived from that current.
.subckt telescopic_cascode_ota vss iref vdd vinn vinp vocm voutn voutp

* ---- Reference diode: defines the nmos gate bias rail at iref (50 uA) ----
XREF iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=6 nf=1

* ---- Main differential signal stack (tail = 300 uA) ----
XTAIL  tail iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=31.2 nf=4
XINP    s1 vinp tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=8.4 nf=2
XINN    s2 vinn tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=8.4 nf=2
XNCASP voutp vcn s1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=8.4 nf=2
XNCASN voutn vcn s2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=8.4 nf=2
XPTOPP   pp vctrl vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=10.2 nf=2
XPTOPN   pn vctrl vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=10.2 nf=2
XPCASP voutp vbpc pp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=34 nf=4
XPCASN voutn vbpc pn vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=34 nf=4

* ---- Cascode bias generation, two 30 uA replica branches ----
* Branch A: two diode pmos -> pmos cascode rail vbpc
XPRT1  pbt1 pbt1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=48 nf=6
XPRT2  vbpc vbpc pbt1 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=48 nf=6
XPRNB  vbpc iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=6 nf=1

* Branch B: pmos (gate = pbt1) over two diode nmos -> nmos cascode rail vcn
XPRTP   vcn pbt1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=48 nf=6
XNRN1   vcn vcn ncmid vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=8.4 nf=2
XNRN2  ncmid ncmid vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=8.4 nf=2

* ---- Continuous-time CMFB ----
* Resistor average of the outputs.
RCMPS voutp vcm_sense 200k
RCMNS voutn vcm_sense 200k

* 50 uA source-coupled nmos pair with diode/mirror pmos load.
* Left leg (diode) compares vocm; right leg drives vctrl.
* Sign: output cm high -> vcm_sense high -> vctrl high -> pmos tops weaken.
XCMT cm_tail iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=6 nf=1
XCML  cm_g vcm_sense cm_tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=1 nf=1
XCMR vctrl vocm cm_tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=1 nf=1
XCMPD cm_g cm_g vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=4 nf=2
XCMPO vctrl cm_g vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=4 nf=2
* Startup: strong pull-down on vctrl while the sensed CM is low;
* |Vsg| < |Vthp| once vcm_sense approaches 0.9 V, so it is off in lock.
XSTART vss vcm_sense vctrl vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=3 nf=1
* Small compensation cap on the cmfb control node.
CCM vctrl vdd 30f
.ends telescopic_cascode_ota

taskTitle: Design a telescopic-cascode fully differential OTA
circuit:
* Sky130 telescopic-cascode fully differential OTA.
.subckt telescopic_cascode_ota vss iref vdd vinn vinp vocm voutn voutp

* ---- iref diode -> vbias_n (NMOS current-source gate, 50 uA) ----
XMref iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=50 nf=5

* Input-CM reference (average of vinp/vinn = 0.9; AC cancels).
RINP vinp ncm 100k
RINN vinn ncm 100k

* ---- vbp_base: PMOS current-source gate bias (diode fed by NMOS sink) ----
XMn_pb psum iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=50 nf=5
XMp_pd psum psum vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=500 nf=50

* ---- vbpc: wide-swing PMOS cascode bias = vdd - Vthp - 2*Vov ----
*   single 1/4-width PMOS diode (source=vdd) + NMOS sink (forces 50 uA).
XMp_cdb vbpc vbpc vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=15 nf=1
XMn_clb vbpc iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=50 nf=5

* ---- vcn: wide-swing NMOS cascode bias tracking input CM = Vin_cm + Vov_casc ----
*   Source follower (gate=ncm) pins tailr = Vin_cm - Vth - Vov_input.
*   1/4-width NMOS diode (source=tailr) adds Vth + 2*Vov_casc -> Vth cancels.
XMn_sf tailr ncm vdd vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=200 nf=20
XMn_sink tailr iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=100 nf=10
XMp_nf vcn psum vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=500 nf=50
XMn_cd vcn vcn tailr vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=50 nf=5

* ---- Telescopic signal stack (tail 100 uA, 50 uA/side) ----
XMt tail iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=100 nf=10
XM1p a1p vinn tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=200 nf=20
XM1n a1n vinp tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=200 nf=20
XM2p voutp vcn a1p vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=200 nf=20
XM2n voutn vcn a1n vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=200 nf=20
XM3p pn vctrl vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=1000 nf=100
XM3n pp vctrl vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=1000 nf=100
XM4p voutp vbpc pn vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=500 nf=50
XM4n voutn vbpc pp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=500 nf=50

* ---- Continuous-time CMFB (resistive sense, diff pair drives PMOS gates) ----
RCMP voutp vcm_sense 5meg
RCMN voutn vcm_sense 5meg
RSTRT vss vctrl 5meg
XCMt cmt iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=25 nf=5
XCMa cmfbd vcm_sense cmt vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=50 nf=5
XCMb vctrl vocm cmt vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=50 nf=5
XCMld cmfbd cmfbd vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=100 nf=10
XCMla vctrl cmfbd vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=100 nf=10
CCM vctrl vss 100f

.ends telescopic_cascode_ota

taskTitle: Design a telescopic-cascode fully differential OTA
circuit:
* Sky130 fully differential telescopic-cascode OTA.
* NMOS: sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8. PMOS: pfet_01v8_lvt (the pfet_01v8 model in
* this install is anomalously weak/subthreshold).
* Cascode bias rails vcn/vbpc are 2-diode stacks (vcn=2*Vgs, vbpc=vdd-2*Vsg),
* density-matched to the signal stack so they track iref over PVT with no
* floating nodes. CMFB is a two-differential-pair CM detector (gate-only
* sensing, no resistive output loading); its control node Q is a low-impedance
* diode so the CM loop is fast and stable, PMOS top sources are its mirror.
* Stack current density ~0.833 uA/um (75 uA in W=90, 50 uA in W=60).
.subckt telescopic_cascode_ota vss iref vdd vinn vinp vocm voutn voutp

* --- Master current mirrors (iref -> NMOS rail iref, PMOS rail p_ref) ---
XREF  iref  iref  vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8     l=1 w=5  nf=1
XN2   p_ref iref  vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8     l=1 w=5  nf=1
XPDI  p_ref p_ref vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=60 nf=6

* --- Tail current source (Itail = 3 x iref = 150 uA, per side 75 uA) ---
XTAIL tail  iref  vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8     l=1 w=15 nf=3

* --- Telescopic signal stack (per side 75 uA, density 0.833 uA/um) ---
XINP   na1  vinp  tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8     l=1 w=90 nf=9
XINN   na2  vinn  tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8     l=1 w=90 nf=9
XNCASN voutn vcn  na1  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8     l=1 w=90 nf=9
XNCASP voutp vcn  na2  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8     l=1 w=90 nf=9
XPTOPN nb1  Q    vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=90 nf=9
XPTOPP nb2  Q    vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=90 nf=9
XPCASN voutn vbpc nb1 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=90 nf=9
XPCASP voutp vbpc nb2 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=90 nf=9

* --- vcn bias = 2*Vgs (NMOS diode stack, density-matched) ---
XPCNv  vcn  p_ref vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=60 nf=6
XVCN1  vcn  vcn   nx   vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8     l=1 w=60 nf=6
XVCN0  nx   nx    vss  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8     l=1 w=60 nf=6

* --- vbpc bias = vdd - 2*Vsg (PMOS diode stack, density-matched) ---
XPPC1  m1   m1    vdd  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=60 nf=6
XPPC2  vbpc vbpc  m1   vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=60 nf=6
XNSV   vbpc iref  vss  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8     l=1 w=5  nf=1

* --- CMFB: two diff pairs detect output CM (gate-only, no resistive load) ---
XCMTa  cmt_a iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8     l=1 w=5  nf=1
XCMTb  cmt_b iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8     l=1 w=5  nf=1
XCMa1  P    voutp cmt_a vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8    l=1 w=60 nf=6
XCMa2  Q    vocm  cmt_a vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8    l=1 w=60 nf=6
XCMb1  P    voutn cmt_b vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8    l=1 w=60 nf=6
XCMb2  Q    vocm  cmt_b vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8    l=1 w=60 nf=6
* PMOS mirror: diode on Q (50 uA) drives injection (75 uA each) => k=1.5.
XCMD   Q    Q    vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=60 nf=6
* Diode load on P gives the vout-sensing diff-pair half a DC current path.
XPLOAD P    P    vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=60 nf=6
* Weak pull-up makes vout=vocm the unique DC operating point (prevents latch).
RQ    vdd  Q    10meg

.ends telescopic_cascode_ota

taskTitle: Design a telescopic-cascode fully differential OTA
circuit:
* Fully differential Sky130 telescopic-cascode operational transconductance
* amplifier.  Interface (fixed by the task bench):
*   .subckt telescopic_cascode_ota vss iref vdd vinn vinp vocm voutn voutp
*
* Architecture
*   * Signal path: NMOS input pair (gates vinp/vinn, common tail current source)
*     folded nowhere - a true telescopic stack.  Each drain drives an NMOS
*     cascode whose drain is the output, and each output is loaded by a
*     PMOS cascode on top of a PMOS current source (the CMFB control node).
*   * Bias: the forced 50 uA into `iref` builds an NMOS mirror (tail current,
*     CMFB error-amplifier tail, two auxiliary branches).  The NMOS cascode
*     gate bias and the PMOS cascode gate bias are both generated with
*     matched-density diodes plus a resistor level shift, so the cascode
*     source nodes (a1/a2 and p1n/p1p) land at supply- and corner-stable
*     voltages.
*   * Common-mode feedback: continuous-time.  Two matched R//C arms average
*     the two outputs onto vcm, an NMOS pair compares vcm with vocm, and its
*     diode-loaded output directly drives the two PMOS current-source gates.
*     The error amplifier is intrinsically symmetric (identical diode loads on
*     both drains) so it has no systematic input offset.
.subckt telescopic_cascode_ota vss iref vdd vinn vinp vocm voutn voutp

* ------------------------------------------------------------------
* Reference mirror (iref is a forced 50 uA) and its NMOS mirrors
* ------------------------------------------------------------------
* Diode that defines the NMOS mirror gate voltage.
XREF   iref  iref  vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=35  nf=1
* Tail current source for the input pair (2 x 90 uA).
XTAIL  tail  iref  vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=136 nf=1
* CMFB error-amplifier tail current (60 uA).
XEAT   eat   iref  vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=42  nf=1
* Auxiliary branch sink for the PMOS-cascode bias (15 uA).
XPCNB  pcas  iref  vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=10.5 nf=1
* Auxiliary branch sink for the PMOS mirror reference (15 uA).
XPNB   pbias iref  vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=10.5 nf=1

* ------------------------------------------------------------------
* PMOS mirror reference (pbias) - only consumer is the ncas branch
* ------------------------------------------------------------------
XPB    pbias pbias vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=20  nf=1

* ------------------------------------------------------------------
* NMOS cascode gate bias (ncas)
*   12 uA from the PMOS mirror, level-shifted through RNCL onto a
*   diode whose current density matches the signal-path NMOS cascodes.
*   v(a1) = i*RNCL - (cascode body effect) is therefore corner stable.
* ------------------------------------------------------------------
XPNCS  ncas  pbias vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=16  nf=1
RNCL   ncas  nd    48k
XND    nd    nd    vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1   w=5.3 nf=1

* ------------------------------------------------------------------
* PMOS cascode gate bias (pcas)
*   15 uA through a diode whose density matches the signal-path PMOS
*   cascodes, then level-shifted by RPCX.  The PMOS current-source
*   VSD ends up equal to i*RPCX (body-effect term aside), so the
*   available output swing does not wander with corner.
* ------------------------------------------------------------------
XPX    pa    pa    vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=10.6 nf=1
RPCX   pa    pcas  22k

* ------------------------------------------------------------------
* Telescopic signal path
* ------------------------------------------------------------------
XINP   a1    vinp  tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1   w=94  nf=1
XINN   a2    vinn  tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1   w=94  nf=1
XNCN   voutn ncas  a1   vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1   w=40  nf=1
XNCP   voutp ncas  a2   vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1   w=40  nf=1
XPLN   p1n   vctrl vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=68.5 nf=1
XPLP   p1p   vctrl vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=68.5 nf=1
XPCAN  voutn pcas  p1n  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=64  nf=1
XPCAP  voutp pcas  p1p  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=64  nf=1

* ------------------------------------------------------------------
* Continuous-time common-mode feedback
* ------------------------------------------------------------------
RCMN   voutn vcm   5meg
RCMP   voutp vcm   5meg
CCMN   voutn vcm   0.2p
CCMP   voutp vcm   0.2p
* Error amplifier: vctrl rises when the sensed common mode rises, which
* throttles the PMOS current sources and pulls the outputs back down.
XEA1   vctrl vocm  eat  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=19.5 nf=1
XEA2   r     vcm   eat  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=19.5 nf=1
XELD1  vctrl vctrl vdd  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=18.2 nf=1
XELD2  r     r     vdd  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=18.2 nf=1
.ends telescopic_cascode_ota

taskTitle: Design a telescopic-cascode fully differential OTA
circuit:
* Fully differential telescopic-cascode OTA, sky130
* pins: vss iref vdd vinn vinp vocm voutn voutp
.subckt telescopic_cascode_ota vss iref vdd vinn vinp vocm voutn voutp

* ------------------------- bias chain -------------------------
* 50uA NMOS reference diode (5uA/um) sets the NMOS mirror gate
XNDIO iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=10
* NMOS mirror carries 50uA into the PMOS reference diode
XNPD  pbias iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=10
XPDD  pbias pbias vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=10

* tail gate bias : 18uA branch, NMOS diode at 0.5uA/um == tail (188uA/360um)
XPTB  vt pbias vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=3.6
XNDB  vt vt vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=34.6

* NMOS cascode gate bias : vcn = VGS(ncas) + 0.45  ->  V(d1) = 0.45
XPTC  vcn pbias vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=2
RVCN  vcn zcn 45k
XNDC  zcn zcn vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4.26

* PMOS cascode gate bias : vbpc = VDD - |VGS(pcas)| - 0.40 -> |VDS(ptop)| = 0.40
XPDB  p1 p1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2.13
RVPB  p1 vbpc 80k
XNVB  vbpc iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=1

* ------------------------- core OTA ---------------------------
* d1/d2 are the input-pair drains; d1 drives the voutn cascode so that
* (voutp - voutn)/(vinp - vinn) is positive.
XTAIL ntail vt vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=360 nf=18
XINP  d1 vinp ntail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=77
XINN  d2 vinn ntail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=77
XNCASN voutn vcn d1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=40 nf=4
XNCASP voutp vcn d2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=40 nf=4
XPCASN voutn vbpc pnn vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=40 nf=4
XPCASP voutp vbpc pnp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=40 nf=4
XPTOPP pnp vctrl vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=15 nf=2
XPTOPN pnn vctrl vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=15 nf=2

* ------------------------- CMFB sense -------------------------
* Ideal 20M resistors give an exact DC average; CFS/CFN give a fast HF path.
RSN voutn vs 20meg
RSP voutp vs 20meg
CFS voutp vs 300f
CFN voutn vs 300f

* ------------------ CMFB amplifier (diode loads) --------------
* vs rising raises vctrl, which cuts the PMOS top current: negative feedback.
XCMP1 cm1 vs ncmt vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=10
XCMP2 vctrl vocm ncmt vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=10
XCMT ncmt vt vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=76.6
XCML1 cm1 cm1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=3.19
XCML2 vctrl vctrl vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=3.19

.ends telescopic_cascode_ota

taskTitle: Design a telescopic-cascode fully differential OTA
circuit:
* Fully differential Sky130 telescopic-cascode OTA.
*
* Signal path: NMOS input pair, NMOS telescopic cascodes, PMOS cascoded
* current sources.  Common-mode feedback senses the output average through
* large R in parallel with small C (fast, unloaded sense), compares it with
* vocm in a low-Vth NMOS pair, and drives the gates of the top PMOS sources
* through a diode load that is a scaled replica of those sources.
.subckt telescopic_cascode_ota vss iref vdd vinn vinp vocm voutn voutp

* ---- NMOS current reference: iref diode, 50 uA at 0.5 uA/um ----
XMR iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=100 nf=2

* ---- PMOS current reference rail pbp (25 uA) ----
XNPS pbp iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=50 nf=1
XMPD pbp pbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=50 nf=1

* ---- NMOS cascode bias: vcn = s1r + Vgs(ncas replica), s1r = Ia*RS1 ----
XMPA vcn pbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=50 nf=1
XNCD vcn vcn s1r vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=12.5 nf=1
RS1 s1r vss 18800

* ---- PMOS cascode bias: RTOP drop 0.40 V sets ptop |Vds| ----
RTOP vdd p1r 16000
XPCD vbpc vbpc p1r vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=25 nf=1
XNPS2 vbpc iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=50 nf=1

* ---- telescopic core ----
XTAIL tail iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=400 nf=8
XINP a1 vinp tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=360 nf=8
XINN a2 vinn tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=360 nf=8
XNCN voutn vcn a1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=50 nf=1
XNCS voutp vcn a2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=50 nf=1
XPTN pnn vctrl vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=56 nf=1
XPTS pnp vctrl vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=56 nf=1
XPCN voutn vbpc pnn vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=95 nf=1
XPCS voutp vbpc pnp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=95 nf=1

* ---- common-mode feedback ----
RSP voutp vsense 100meg
RSN voutn vsense 100meg
CSP voutp vsense 1p
CSN voutn vsense 1p
XMDV dmy vsense detn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=50 nf=1
XMDR vctrl vocm detn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=50 nf=1
XMDT detn iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=250 nf=5
XMPLD vctrl vctrl vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=18.6 nf=1
XMPLX dmy dmy vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=18.6 nf=1
.ends telescopic_cascode_ota

taskTitle: Design a telescopic-cascode fully differential OTA
circuit:
* Fully differential Sky130 telescopic-cascode OTA.
* NMOS telescopic cascode core, PMOS cascode current-source load,
* continuous-time common-mode feedback driving the PMOS top mirror.
.subckt telescopic_cascode_ota vss iref vdd vinn vinp vocm voutn voutp

* ------------------------------------------------------------------
* Reference branch: the 50 uA pin forward-biases a diode-connected NFET.
* ------------------------------------------------------------------
XREF iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=25 nf=1

* Tail mirror, 2.4x the reference -> 120 uA tail (60 uA per side).
XTAIL tv1 iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=60 nf=3

* ------------------------------------------------------------------
* PMOS cascode gate bias vbpc: diode-connected PFET with a large VOD so
* that vbpc tracks vdd and the top device keeps its saturation margin.
* ------------------------------------------------------------------
XNBS vbpc iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=25 nf=1
XPCAS vbpc vbpc vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=11 nf=1

* NMOS cascode gate bias vcn: PFET mirror feeding a diode-connected NFET.
XPCB vcn vbpc vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=12 nf=1
XVCNB vcn vcn vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=2 nf=1

* ------------------------------------------------------------------
* Telescopic cascore signal path.
* ------------------------------------------------------------------
XINP a1 vinp tv1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=32 nf=2
XINN a2 vinn tv1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=32 nf=2
XNC1 n1 vcn a1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=37 nf=2
XNC2 n2 vcn a2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=37 nf=2
XPC1 n1 vbpc pn1 pn1 sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=90 nf=2
XPC2 n2 vbpc pn2 pn2 sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=90 nf=2
XPT1 pn1 vctrl vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=25 nf=1
XPT2 pn2 vctrl vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=25 nf=1

* ------------------------------------------------------------------
* Common-mode feedback: capacitive/resistive average sense, lvt diff
* pair referenced to vocm, diode-loaded output that also biases the
* PMOS top current sources.
* ------------------------------------------------------------------
RCMN voutn cm_s 4meg
RCMP voutp cm_s 4meg
CCSN voutn cm_s 0.3p
CCSP voutp cm_s 0.3p

XCMS ctd cm_s ct1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=3 nf=1
XCMR ctr vocm ct1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=3 nf=1
XCMD1 vdd_dummy vdd vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=1 nf=1
XCMT ct1 iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=33 nf=1

.ends telescopic_cascode_ota

taskTitle: Design a telescopic-cascode fully differential OTA
circuit:
* Fully differential Sky130 telescopic-cascode OTA.
* NMOS-input telescopic stack; dual-differential-pair CMFB drives the top sources.
.subckt telescopic_cascode_ota vss iref vdd vinn vinp vocm voutn voutp

* ---------------- reference: 50 uA forced into iref ----------------
XREF iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=30.0 nf=6

* ---------------- tail current source ----------------
XTAIL tail iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=96.0 nf=19

* ---------------- input differential pair ----------------
XINN ap vinn tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=48.0 nf=10
XINP an vinp tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=48.0 nf=10

* ---------------- NMOS cascodes ----------------
XNCASN voutn vcn an vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=250.0 nf=50
XNCASP voutp vcn ap vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=250.0 nf=50

* ---------------- PMOS cascodes ----------------
XPCASN voutn vbpc pn vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=250.0 nf=50
XPCASP voutp vbpc pp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=250.0 nf=50

* ---------------- top current sources, gate = vctrl (CMFB) ----------------
XPTOPN pn vctrl vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=2.0 w=90 nf=9
XPTOPP pp vctrl vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=2.0 w=90 nf=9

* ---------------- vbp: PMOS mirror reference ----------------
XNBRS vbp iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=15.0 nf=2
XPBRS vbp vbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=22.0 nf=2

* ---------------- vcn = Vgs(nmos diode) + I*R ----------------
RVCN vcn ncmid 34.0k
XNCDI ncmid ncmid vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=100.0 nf=8
XPVCN vcn vbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=14.0 nf=2

* ---------------- vbpc = vdd - Vsg(pmos diode) - I*R ----------------
RPBC nbpd vbpc 5.2k
XPPCD nbpd nbpd vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=66.0 nf=8
XPBCS vbpc iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=36.0 nf=4

* ---------------- CMFB: two matched differential pairs ----------------
XCMS1 cmy voutp cs1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=16.0 nf=4
XCMS2 vctrl vocm cs1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=16.0 nf=4
XCMS3 cmy voutn cs2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=16.0 nf=4
XCMS4 vctrl vocm cs2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=16.0 nf=4

circuit:
* Telescopic-cascode fully differential OTA (candidate 1).
* Interface: vss iref vdd vinn vinp vocm voutn voutp ; iref forced to 50 uA externally.
.subckt telescopic_cascode_ota vss iref vdd vinn vinp vocm voutn voutp
*--------------------------------------------------------------------*
* Bias: reference voltage from the forced 50 uA at iref.
*--------------------------------------------------------------------*
XMREF   iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=10 nf=1
* Tail current source: 100 uA total (50 uA per side).
XMTAIL  tail iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=20 nf=2
* Cascode/load bias rail: vbpc mirrors the 50 uA load devices.
XMNB    x    iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=10 nf=1
XMPB    x    x    vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=20 nf=2
*--------------------------------------------------------------------*
* Differential input pair (50 uA per side at balance).
*--------------------------------------------------------------------*
XMINP   sn   vinp tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=40 nf=5
XMINN   sp   vinn tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=40 nf=5
* NMOS cascode devices (low overdrive for output swing).
XMCASP  voutn vcn sn   vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=80 nf=8
XMCASN  voutp vcn sp   vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=80 nf=8
* PMOS common-gate current-source loads (50 uA each).
XMPP    voutp x    vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=20 nf=2
XMPN    voutn x    vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=20 nf=2
*--------------------------------------------------------------------*
* Continuous-time CMFB: senses output CM, compares to vocm, drives vcn.
*--------------------------------------------------------------------*
RCMP   voutp vsense 200k
RCMN   voutn vsense 200k
XMPEP   pep   vocm   vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=10 nf=2
XMPEN   pen   vsense vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=10 nf=2
XMTAILE pes  x      vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=10 nf=2
XMNDL   pnode pnode  vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=10 nf=1
XMNDN   vcn   pnode  vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=10 nf=1
CCM    vcn   vss    2p
RSTART vcn   vdd    1meg
ROUTP  voutp  vss    10meg
ROUTN  voutn  vss    10meg
RA     pes    x      1meg
.ic v(vcn)=1.0 v(voutn)=0.9 v(voutp)=0.9 v(sn)=0.45 v(sp)=0.45 v(pes)=1.5 v(pnode)=0.6 v(tail)=0.27
.ends telescopic_cascode_ota
